name: Condemn
oracle_text: Put target attacking creature on the bottom of its owner's library. Its controller gains life equal to its toughness.
blocked_sentences: Put target attacking creature on the bottom of its owner's library. Its controller gains life equal to its toughness.

needs.what: The authoring verification sandbox (cards/authoring/verify.py build_sandbox / sandbox_turn / _cast) must be able to cast an instant whose only target must be an attacking creature: move the sandbox into a combat (an opponent's creature declared as an attacker, the spell cast in declare attackers or declare blockers) when a card-level target selector, or one of its any_of branches, carries attacking/blocking -- the same need already filed by devouring_light
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Every printed word is expressible: a `permanent` target t1 with selector {zone: battlefield, controller: any, types: [Creature], attacking: true}; spell_effects [{op: snapshot, target: t1, as: condemned}, {op: put_on_top, objects: {target: t1}, bottom: true} (op_put_on_top always uses the owner's library), {op: gain_life, player: {controller_of: condemned}, amount: {toughness_of: {var: condemned}}}]. But the sandbox is fixed at player 0's precombat main with combat declined, and sandbox_turn only moves for a cast_only_during window, so no creature is ever attacking: the cast has no legal target (601.2c) and gate 4 reports 'not playable in the sandbox', as it did for devouring_light. No expectation key can be met by a card that cannot be cast, and widening the target to any creature or adding an unprinted cast window would be an approximation
